title: Stalks commute with direct sums of sheaf modules
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], let $I$ be a set, and let $(\mathcal F_i)_{i\in I}$ be sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For every $x\in X$, the canonical $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-linear map from the stalk of the coproduct to the coproduct of the stalks is an isomorphism $$(\bigoplus_{i\in I}\mathcal F_i)_x\;\xrightarrow{\sim}\;\bigoplus_{i\in I}(\mathcal F_i)_x,$$ where the coproducts are taken in the category of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules and of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-modules, respectively.
